## Triage: first grade, `enhancement` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T14:54Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 + `target:v18`:** it is a child of the print-page series (objectstack#8346 B′, card ③ objectstack#22269). The maintainer's rule 「PDF 要赶 18.0 正式版」 puts the PDF chain at p1. Without a route to a NAMED record page, a print page must replace its object's default record page for every user, as the showcase invoice had to.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. Re-read on `main` `5c0846ebd8`: `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:640` calls `usePageAssignment(objectName)` with no `pageName`. A named-page route is a console URL contract. If it needs a served field, the claim declares `Clause-②`.

Claim: PM loop round 4 (`priority:p1`, `target:v18`; the print-page chain, triage grade `6218185186`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12715-named-record-page`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12715` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: a console route that renders record R of object O on a named record page P.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`: one new route beside `:objectName/record/:recordId` (`:1135`) and its in-app twin, if it has one. Only the route lines.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: hand the named page to `usePageAssignment`, and refuse visibly when P is not a `type: 'record'` page bound to O.
- `packages/react/src/hooks/usePageAssignment.ts`: only if the type and object check must live in the hook (see the Clause-② reason).
- tests beside each, and one `.changeset/12715-*.md` per touched released package.

Outside the surface:
- The default route's behaviour, which stays unchanged.
- The print stylesheet and print root code (`page-print.ts`, `PrintPageProvider`), read only to prove Acceptance 3.
- objectstack's `service-print`, which binds to the URL afterwards.
- `DetailSection.tsx` (objectui#12717).

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the three planned paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: a new console URL shape for a record on a named page is a public contract; objectstack's print service binds to it, so the console's public surface widens. If the dev narrows the published `usePageAssignment` `pageName` override itself (today it returns any page by name, with no check on type or object), that part is a narrowing of a published hook and owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before ready. A check at the route keeps the hook unchanged.
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card
Thread-read: 6218185186
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `5c0846ebd8`.
- PR #12685 (objectui#12082, another seat) adds only a test file beside `RecordDetailView.tsx`, not the view itself.
- objectui#12675 (this seat, in flight) may touch `AppContent.tsx`'s `system/marketplace/installed` routes, a different region of the file. It is ordinary concurrency; the later lander merges `main`.
- No open PR or other claim names `RecordDetailView.tsx` or `usePageAssignment.ts`.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#23811 (service-print) is still open. Nothing here waits on it: this card defines the URL, and objectstack binds to it after the pin moves.

2. **URL shape: A**, the path segment `/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID/page/PAGE`. objectstack's print service binds to this spelling after its pin moves.
3. **Refusal copy: A**, the one existing not-found state.

**Widened surface:** the claim's surface is widened, on record, for two docs pages (`content/docs/guide/print-pages.md`, `console-architecture.md`). Both name the URL; they are prose faces that follow the implementation.

**A related reading from objectui#12717's dev** (its report, `out_of_scope_findings[2]`): at the next.2 pin, a throwaway page-level `print` on a showcase record page never reached `/api/v1/meta/page`. This card's dev did read a print root live on a throwaway print record page, so the route itself serves it. The seat notes that reading here, unfiled.
